**Event:** Invited research talk, College of Business\
**Location:** State University of New York at Stony Brook, USA\
**Host:** Prof. Dr. Manuel London

## Context

Traditional measures of implicit motives rely on trained coders scoring picture-story
exercises, which limits the scale at which motive research can be conducted. This talk
presented work on using large language models to code motive imagery, and asked what
becomes possible for organizational research once motive assessment is no longer
constrained by manual coding capacity.
